content: Whisper model hosting: official ggml models live at https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/ggml-<name>.bin (tiny ~75MB q5 variant smaller, base, small). The official download-ggml-model.sh does NOT verify checksums - apps must embed their own SHA-256 catalog and verify after download (spec section 5.4 justified). Pattern: OkHttp streaming download (+Range resume), DigestInputStream SHA-256 computed while writing, compare then atomic rename into filesDir/whisper_models; never load until verified.
